leadText:
The Ho-Oh Shrine (Japanese: ホウオウのほこら Hohou Shrine) is an -exclusive location found on Mt. Silver in the Johto region. It was featured in Pop Goes The Sneasel.

The shrine and the surrounding temple grounds were built in honor of . Legends explain that people once ravaged the place so badly that the Pokémon suffered because of it and the vegetation was wiped out. Ho-Oh appeared afterwards and unleashed a that set the area alight and destroyed the weapons of war, subsequently triggering new life and the restoration of the area. However, one tree branch continued to burn. This flame was later housed in the Ho-Oh Shrine and called the "Sacred Flame". The Sacred Flame continues to burn as a symbol of peace in the present day, and it is used to announce the opening ceremony of the Johto League Silver Conference.

In Pop Goes The Sneasel, a , , and were attacking anyone who got too close to the Sacred Flame. The attendant feared the opening of the Silver Conference would be delayed, though , , and intervened. Harrison went on to the Sneasel, while the attendant employed Machop and Machoke as permanent guards for the shrine. The much-anticipated torch relay later began, and the Silver Conference resumed as planned.
